title: Closed containment locus for a Hilbert subscheme
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $i:W\hookrightarrow X_T$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let $Z\hookrightarrow X_T$ be a closed subscheme whose structure morphism $Z\to T$ is finite locally free of degree $d$ [def-pc-finite-locally-free]. Then there exists a closed subscheme $T_W\hookrightarrow T$ such that, for every morphism $T'\to T$ over $S$, the pullback $Z_{T'}\hookrightarrow X_{T'}$ factors through $W_{T'}\hookrightarrow X_{T'}$ if and only if $T'\to T$ factors through $T_W\hookrightarrow T$. The construction is compatible with arbitrary base change in $T$.
